_about: Water (1) + ethylene-glycol (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa, binary data set from Kamihama et al. (2012). Rows as in the ThermoML Archive record: liquid mole fraction of water, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of water.

source.citation: N. Kamihama, H. Matsuda, K. Kurihara, K. Tochigi, S. Oba, Isobaric Vapor-Liquid Equilibria for Ethanol + Water + Ethylene Glycol and Its Constituent Three Binary Systems, J. Chem. Eng. Data 57 (2012) 339-344
source.access: Journal article is subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 6 (boiling temperature) and 7 (vapour mole fraction): the binary water + ethylene glycol set. The table number in the article was not checked (article not open).

notes: Expanded uncertainties per point in the ThermoML record: T from 4.49 K to 0.46 K, y_1 from 0.099 to 0.002. No pure-component rows in the set. Values as stored in the ThermoML record (XML file), extracted with validation/python/thermoml_read.py; nothing converted or rounded. To be checked by a person against the record before use (AGENTS.md rule 4).
